item.description:
### Added - **The Herdr desktop app.** Clicking a session that runs in the Herdr app now jumps to its exact pane and brings Herdr to the front, instead of opening Ghostty. You can also reply to Claude sessions there and stop them from your iPhone.
### Fixed - **herdr 0.9 works again.** Perch couldn't talk to herdr 0.9, so jumping to a pane, replying and Stop didn't work for herdr sessions. They do now. A reply herdr doesn't confirm in time shows as "sent, not confirmed", so you don't send it twice. - **A reply never lands on top of what you're typing.** If you have a half-typed message in a herdr pane, Perch won't add your iPhone reply to it. It tells you to send or clear it first. For now, herdr replies work for Claude Code only; other agents in herdr still jump and stop. - **herdr is found when your shell sets `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`.**
